fields.label: Pets
fields.prompt: Are pets/dogs allowed? 'allowed' ONLY on an explicit confirmation (pets allowed, pet friendly, dogs ok, สัตว์เลี้ยงได้). 'not_allowed' ONLY on an explicit ban. In every other case 'unclear'. Always put the quote in ev.

fields.label: Pets — quote
fields.prompt: The verbatim quote from the ad on which the pets field is based. Empty string if the text says nothing about pets.

fields.label: Price ฿/mo
fields.prompt: The real monthly price in THB that the tenant pays. If the ad gives a rate grid, take the rate closest to a one-year contract. No currency symbol, number only.

fields.label: Price 12 mo ฿
fields.prompt: The price for a 12-month contract, if the ad gives a rate grid by term. Otherwise leave empty.

fields.label: Deposit
fields.prompt: Deposit and prepayment terms as written, briefly: '2 months deposit + 1 in advance'.

fields.label: Bedrooms
fields.prompt: Number of bedrooms. Studio is 0. More bedrooms than needed is a plus, not a problem.

fields.label: Bathrooms
fields.prompt: Number of bathrooms/toilets.

fields.label: Extra rooms
fields.prompt: Rooms beyond the bedrooms and the living room: study, second living room, storage room, enclosed terrace. Briefly, comma-separated.

fields.label: Living room
fields.prompt: Whether there is a separate living room. If it is simply not mentioned, 'unclear' - that is NOT a defect. 'no' only when the ad says explicitly that the living area is combined or absent.

fields.label: Furnished
fields.prompt: Level of furnishing: 'full' (fully furnished), 'partial' (partly, only kitchen/built-ins), 'none' (empty), 'unclear'.

fields.label: Type
fields.prompt: Property type. Set 'studio' ONLY on the explicit word studio or when one room without a bedroom is described - it leads to an auto-reject.

fields.label: Project/village
fields.prompt: Name of the village, project or condo (Pruksa Ville, Supalai, The Base, etc.). Empty if not given.

fields.label: District
fields.prompt: Normalized Phuket district in Latin script: Kathu, Bang Tao, Cherngtalay, Rawai, Nai Harn, Chalong, Wichit, Thalang, Phuket Town, Kata, Karon, Kamala, Patong, etc. The district is scored by code, so put FIRST the one where the house itself stands, and details and landmarks after a comma ('Kathu, 10 min to Patong', not the other way round).

fields.label: Size m²
fields.prompt: Living area in square metres. If the land plot area is given separately, take the house area.

fields.label: Floors
fields.prompt: Number of floors in the house/townhouse. For a condo the floor does not matter, leave empty.

fields.label: Condition
fields.prompt: Condition of the property by the description and any mention of renovation: 'new' (new / just completed), 'good', 'worn' (needs renovation), 'unclear'.

fields.label: Light
fields.prompt: How much daylight the home gets, by the photos: size and number of windows, daylight in the rooms, whether a window faces a wall or the next block, whether a ground floor is dark. 'bright' ONLY with large windows and daylight in several rooms; 'dark' - small windows, a view into a wall, rooms without windows. Flash, wide-angle and HDR make anything look bright, so a bright frame on its own is not proof - when in doubt 'unclear'. In ev say which windows you judge by.

fields.label: Appeal
fields.prompt: Overall impression of the home itself by the photos, grounded in what is visible: freshness of the finish, room space, upkeep, clutter, the view from the window. This rates the flat, not the photo quality: a well-shot tired flat is 'unattractive', an amateur shot of a fresh renovation is 'attractive'. 'ok' - ordinary decent housing with nothing outstanding and no defects. If there are few photos or they do not show the living rooms - 'unclear'. In ev list the visible things the rating is built from.

fields.label: View
fields.prompt: What the windows and the outdoor terrace look onto in the photos: 'sea' (sea, lagoon), 'green' (garden, village greenery, jungle, hill, field), 'city' (buildings, street, roofs - without facing a wall), 'wall' (the wall of the next block, a blank fence, a car park, a vent shaft, a window into a corridor), 'unclear' - no windows visible in the photos or shot from inside against the light. Judge only by what is really visible in the window: a sea view from the shared pool or the roof of the complex is not the view from the flat. In ev say in which photo and in which window.

fields.label: Kitchen
fields.prompt: Kitchen: 'full' (proper kitchen with a stove/oven), 'kitchenette' (mini kitchen, hot plate), 'none', 'unclear'.

fields.label: Parking
fields.prompt: Whether there is a parking space for a car.

fields.label: Internet
fields.prompt: Internet: speed, provider, data cap, whether it is included in the price - if given. Otherwise empty.

fields.label: Utilities
fields.prompt: What the rent includes and what is paid on top: internet, common fee, electricity, water, their rates - as written, briefly. Empty if not stated.

fields.label: Air con
fields.prompt: Number and placement of air conditioners, if given ('2 units: bedroom + living room').

fields.label: Pool/gym
fields.prompt: Pool, gym and other facilities - private or shared, briefly.

fields.label: Green area
fields.prompt: Whether there is a green area/park/yard nearby where a dog can be walked. 'yes' on a mention of a garden, a park, or a green village yard.

fields.label: Security
fields.prompt: Gated village/guard post/24h security/CCTV at the entrance.

fields.label: Min contract, mo
fields.prompt: Minimum rental term in months. A one-year contract is needed - if the place is let only monthly/daily, that is a flag, not a reject.

fields.label: Available from
fields.prompt: The date from which the home is free, in YYYY-MM-DD format. It is needed by the move-in date given in the requirements letter. Empty if not given.

fields.label: Date in text
fields.prompt: The ad's publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format, if it is visible in the text.

fields.label: Posted by
fields.prompt: Who posts: 'agent' (agency, realtor, mention of a commission), 'owner' (the owner), 'unclear'.

fields.label: Contact
fields.prompt: Phone, LINE ID, WhatsApp - as given. The text often contains '[hidden information]'; record it as such.

fields.label: Photos show
fields.prompt: What the photos actually show: 'real' (real shots of this property), 'render' (3D visualization/render instead of photos), 'floorplan' (floor plans only), 'other_unit' (clearly a different unit - different layout/floor), 'unclear'. On 'render' do not fill the other photo fields.
